query: What is the total ACV across all active contracts in India?
ground_truth: Aggregate active contract ACV by region
reference_sql: SELECT SUM(acv_usd) AS total_acv FROM niiha_contracts WHERE region = 'INDIA' AND status = 'Active';
description: Aggregate active contract ACV by region

ground_truth: Find clients with overdue invoices joining contracts and invoices
reference_sql: SELECT c.client_name, i.invoice_id, i.amount_usd, i.days_overdue FROM niiha_invoices i JOIN niiha_contracts c ON i.contract_id = c.contract_id WHERE i.days_overdue > 0 ORDER BY i.days_overdue DESC;
description: Find clients with overdue invoices joining contracts and invoices

query: What is the total expense amount by department in Q1 2026?
ground_truth: Group department expenses by quarter matching Q1-2026 format
reference_sql: SELECT department, SUM(amount_usd) AS total_spent FROM niiha_expenses WHERE quarter = 'Q1-2026' GROUP BY department ORDER BY total_spent DESC;
description: Group department expenses by quarter matching Q1-2026 format

query: Which active contracts violate our FY 2026 autonomous or executive discount approval rules?
ground_truth: Cross-reference discount policy thresholds against niiha_contracts
reference_sql: SELECT contract_id, client_name, acv_usd, discount_pct, contract_months, approved_by FROM niiha_contracts WHERE status = 'Active' AND ((discount_pct > 25.0 AND approved_by != 'CFO') OR (acv_usd < 50000 AND contract_months = 12 AND discount_pct > 10.0 AND approved_by = 'Auto') OR (acv_usd >= 50000 AND acv_usd < 250000 AND contract_months = 12 AND discount_pct > 15.0 AND approved_by = 'Auto') OR (acv_usd >= 250000 AND contract_months = 12 AND discount_pct > 20.0 AND approved_by = 'Auto'));
description: Cross-reference discount policy thresholds against niiha_contracts

query: Which clients should be flagged as High Credit Risk and restricted from license expansions?
ground_truth: Identify accounts with 2+ overdue invoices exceeding 45 days past due per credit risk policy
reference_sql: SELECT c.contract_id, c.client_name, COUNT(i.invoice_id) AS overdue_count, SUM(i.amount_usd) AS total_overdue_usd FROM niiha_contracts c JOIN niiha_invoices i ON c.contract_id = i.contract_id WHERE i.payment_status = 'Overdue' AND i.days_overdue > 45 GROUP BY c.contract_id, c.client_name HAVING COUNT(i.invoice_id) >= 2 ORDER BY overdue_count DESC;
description: Identify accounts with 2+ overdue invoices exceeding 45 days past due per credit risk policy

query: List all Q3 2026 expense claims that exceed our per-night hotel caps, dining per-attendee limits, or receipt rules.
ground_truth: Audit Q3-2026 expenses against SOP-FIN-2026-04 hotel, dining, and receipt rules
reference_sql: SELECT expense_id, department, category, city_tier, amount_usd, nights_or_attendees, receipt_attached FROM niiha_expenses WHERE quarter = 'Q3-2026' AND ((category = 'Hotel' AND city_tier = 'Tier-1' AND (amount_usd / nights_or_attendees) > 280) OR (category = 'Hotel' AND city_tier = 'Tier-2' AND (amount_usd / nights_or_attendees) > 160) OR (category = 'Client Dining' AND (amount_usd / nights_or_attendees) > 75) OR (amount_usd > 25 AND receipt_attached = FALSE));
description: Audit Q3-2026 expenses against SOP-FIN-2026-04 hotel, dining, and receipt rules

query: Which recurring Cloud/SaaS expenses require a FinOps Cost-Benefit Review?
ground_truth: Flag Cloud/SaaS expenditures exceeding $2,500 threshold per SOP-FIN-2026-04
reference_sql: SELECT expense_id, department, amount_usd, quarter FROM niiha_expenses WHERE category = 'Cloud/SaaS' AND amount_usd > 2500 ORDER BY amount_usd DESC;
description: Flag Cloud/SaaS expenditures exceeding $2,500 threshold per SOP-FIN-2026-04

query: Compare departmental spending per quarter against our FY 2026 quarterly budget caps.
ground_truth: Aggregate quarterly departmental expenses to compare against SOP-FIN-2026-04 budget caps
reference_sql: SELECT department, quarter, SUM(amount_usd) AS total_spent FROM niiha_expenses GROUP BY department, quarter ORDER BY quarter, total_spent DESC;
description: Aggregate quarterly departmental expenses to compare against SOP-FIN-2026-04 budget caps
